rationale: Retain the existing production company as the sole canonical Transportation Equipment Network record, retire the duplicate parenthetical seed identity, and correct the platform's ownership and history. Direct manager evidence establishes that I Squared began building the platform by acquiring Star Leasing through Fund II in March 2021, then brought Mubadala, QIA and other co-investors into TEN in July 2024. Meketa identifies TEN as a current MIFAX co-investment, and an SEC filing discloses a separate 6.29% Series II common-stock interest as of March 31, 2026. Exact percentages and vehicles for the other current owners are not publicly disclosed, so no equal ownership is inferred.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Transportation Equipment Network (TEN) is an asset-owning North American commercial-trailer leasing and fleet-services platform serving carriers, shippers and logistics operators. It provides trailer leasing and rentals, maintenance, fleet technology and advisory services, refrigerated-equipment support and storage through an integrated network assembled from Star Leasing, Cooling Concepts, NETS, Commercial Trailer Leasing, TIP Canada and Boston Trailer. Current company disclosures describe approximately 83,000 trailers, about 1,000 employees and nearly 50 locations across the United States and Canada. I Squared began building the platform through ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund II's March 2021 acquisition of employee-owned Star Leasing. TEN became the common trade identity effective July 1, 2024, when Mubadala, QIA and other co-investors invested more than $600 million. Meketa Infrastructure Fund and a separate ISQ Open Infrastructure Company Series II position are also publicly disclosed current interests. Exact post-2024 ownership percentages, securities and vehicles are not fully public; the only precise current percentage found is Series II's 6.29% indirect common-stock interest at March 31, 2026. No later platform sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.

ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund II acquired employee-owned Star Leasing, beginning I Squared's build of the TEN platform.
The platform added Cooling Concepts, NETS and Commercial Trailer Leasing, consolidating complementary trailer-leasing and services businesses beneath one manager-level platform.
I Squared announced more than $600 million of new equity from Mubadala, QIA and other co-investors for TEN following the TIP Canada combination and July 1 rebrand.
Star Leasing and the integrated businesses adopted Transportation Equipment Network as their common North American trade identity.
Meketa Infrastructure Fund disclosed TEN as a co-investment; its exact stake and security are not publicly disclosed.
ISQ Open Infrastructure Company Series II reported a 6.29% indirect common-stock interest in TEN.
